Pinterest Marketing - Terms & Conditions

Done-for-you Pinterest marketing for Etsy and Shopify sellers — built to turn your listings into a consistent, compounding traffic channel.

Who We Are

GrowMyPin is a Pinterest marketing agency for e-commerce sellers. We manage the strategy, creative, and daily execution of your store's Pinterest presence so you can focus on running your shop. Trusted by Shopify and Etsy sellers across multiple product categories.

What We Do

  • Full Pinterest account setup and optimization for your brand, managed through Pinterest's official Business Manager (publisher access)
  • 160+ pins published every month, hand-crafted and scheduled consistently
  • 10 blogs created every month, linked through your pins for long-form discovery
  • Keyword-optimized titles and descriptions on every single pin so the right audience discovers you
  • A consistent posting cadence tuned to your niche and the Pinterest algorithm
  • Weekly performance reporting so you always know where things stand

What We Don't Do

  • We don't guarantee sales — Pinterest drives discovery and traffic; conversion depends on your listing, pricing, and offer
  • We don't have full control over Pinterest's algorithm — we do target and optimize for the right audience and geography as far as possible, but final distribution is decided by Pinterest itself
  • We don't run outside your account's fair-use guidelines — everything we do stays aligned with Pinterest's own policies

Reporting & Data Sharing

  • Every Sunday, you export your Pinterest analytics (CSV) from your account and share it with us — this keeps our reporting accurate and transparent
  • Every Sunday, you also share your Etsy/Shopify store's sales, views, and visits data with us, so we can tie Pinterest activity back to real store performance
  • Your name and store identity are never shared with anyone without your explicit consent
  • With your explicit consent, and where legally and ethically permitted, your anonymized analytics (views, growth numbers) may be used as social proof for prospective clients — without revealing your identity or store details

How It Works

1. Free 3-Day Trial

We set up and run your Pinterest account for 3 days, at no cost, so you can see the quality of our work before committing.

2. Onboarding

We study your shop, your best-selling listings, and your niche to build a content plan around what already sells.

3. Daily Execution

We publish optimized pins consistently, using keyword research and creative best practices for your category.

4. Growth & Reporting

We track views, reach, and engagement weekly (via your shared analytics) and adjust strategy as your account matures.

Pricing

Simple, growth-linked pricing. You start free, pay a small base charge to keep your account professionally managed, and pay more only as your account actually grows.

StageCharge

Milestone charges apply once and reflect the value delivered at that traffic level. Charges beyond 2,00,000 monthly views remain capped at Rs 9,999.

Important Notes

  • The initial Rs 999 charge covers account setup and management effort and is not refundable, since this reflects our upfront work and acquisition cost.
  • The Rs 4,000 month-end charge is mandatory and applies regardless of milestone views reached — it covers the full month of active management (160+ pins, 10 blogs, weekly reporting).
  • Pinterest's final audience distribution is decided by its own algorithm — we optimize and target for the right audience and geography, but cannot guarantee the outcome.
  • Results depend on niche, product quality, and consistency — most accounts see initial traction within 2-3 weeks of optimized posting.

Risk & Return Policy

A clear breakdown of what is protected and what isn't, so there are no surprises.

Initial Charge (Rs 999)

This amount is not covered by any refund or return-risk guarantee. It covers the cost of account setup, onboarding, and the upfront management effort we put in before any growth is visible — this is the risk we take on ourselves as the service provider.

Milestone Charges (Rs 1,499 / Rs 2,499 / Rs 4,999 / Rs 9,999)

These charges are covered by our return-risk policy. Each milestone charge is only applied once your account has genuinely reached that traffic level. If the milestone is not sustained afterward, that specific charge remains protected under this policy.

Month-End Charge (Rs 4,000, Month 1)

This charge is mandatory and applies at the end of month 1 regardless of the milestone reached — it covers the full month of active management and is not tied to a specific views target.

What This Policy Does Not Cover

  • Sales or revenue outcomes — this policy covers our service charges only, not your business results
  • Audience geography or demographics, which are determined by Pinterest's own algorithm
  • Account suspensions or restrictions caused by pre-existing issues on your Etsy/Shopify listings

Data Privacy Policy

What we collect, how we use it, and exactly what stays private — no surprises.

Your Identity Stays Private

Your name, your store name, and any other identifying details about your business are never shared with anyone — including other clients or prospective clients — without your explicit, separate consent.

What We Collect

  • Weekly Pinterest analytics (CSV export) shared by you, used to track and report on your account's growth
  • Weekly Etsy/Shopify sales, views, and visits data shared by you, used to connect Pinterest activity to real store outcomes

How Your Data May Be Used

With your explicit consent, and only where legally and ethically permitted, your anonymized performance numbers (such as views or growth percentages) may be shown to prospective clients as social proof of results. This is always done without your name, your store name, or any other detail that could identify you or your business.

What We Never Do

  • We never share your store link, product listings, or shop name with other clients or third parties
  • We never use your data for anything beyond managing and reporting on your own Pinterest account
  • We never use your analytics as social proof without asking you first, separately from this document
